name: Habakkuk
title: The Questioning Prophet
summary: Habakkuk is unique among the prophets because he did not speak to the people on God's behalf, but to God on behalf of the people. He asked the difficult questions about why God allows evil and injustice. The answer he received—that the righteous shall live by faith—became foundational for Christian theology.

keyEvents.title: First Lament
keyEvents.description: Habakkuk asked God why He did not intervene against the injustice in Judah.

keyEvents.title: God's Surprising Answer
keyEvents.description: God answered that He would use the Babylonians as His instrument of punishment.

keyEvents.title: The Righteous Shall Live by Faith
keyEvents.description: God revealed that the righteous shall live by their faith—a central verse in the NT.

keyEvents.title: Habakkuk's Song of Praise
keyEvents.description: Habakkuk concluded with a powerful song of praise, resolving to rejoice in God regardless of circumstances.
